rules: When a publish-request.md for a user-approved channel package is saved and ready for publishing.
When a task-request.md for other computer work (site data, research, source capture, media download, screenshots, or tool work) is saved and ready.
When task-result.md is saved for a request marked 'Requested by: Marketing Content Creator', with outcome Completed, Blocked, or Needs Decision.
When the user asks to run a reply search now, to start, stop or change the reply timer or a watch list, or to skip a reply candidate.
When reply-queue.md has new candidates for the user, when a reply search came back Blocked, or when a request from the Content Creator is done.
When a task-request.md for a read-only collection of recent posts, marked 'Requested by: Marketing Reply Scout', is saved and ready.
When task-result.md is saved for a request marked 'Requested by: Marketing Reply Scout', with outcome Completed, Blocked, or Needs Decision.
When an analysis-request.md for a performance review, strategy question, or start of tracking is saved and ready.
When a task-request.md to collect public data (views, likes and replies of published posts, or pages for the Analyst's own research) is saved and ready.
When task-result.md is saved for a request marked 'Requested by: Marketing Performance Analyst', with outcome Completed, Blocked, or Needs Decision.
When performance-analysis.md is saved with outcome Completed, Blocked, or Needs Decision.
